ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayat.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun

ayat.arabic: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: AAamilatun nasibatun

ayat.arabic: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ
ayat.transliteration: Tasla naran hamiyatan

ayat.arabic: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin

ayat.arabic: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
ayat.transliteration: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

ayat.arabic: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
ayat.transliteration: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun

ayat.arabic: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: LisaAAyiha radiyatun

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

ayat.arabic: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ
ayat.transliteration: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun

ayat.arabic: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun

ayat.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Wanamariqu masfoofatun

ayat.arabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
ayat.transliteration: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
ayat.transliteration: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
ayat.transliteration: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
ayat.transliteration: Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
ayat.transliteration: Waila alardi kayfa sutihat

ayat.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ
ayat.transliteration: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun

ayat.arabic: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
ayat.transliteration: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayat.transliteration: Illa man tawalla wakafara

ayat.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
ayat.transliteration: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
ayat.transliteration: Inna ilayna iyabahum

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayat.transliteration: Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Waalfajri

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ
ayat.transliteration: Walayalin AAashrin

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Waallayli itha yasri

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
ayat.transliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayat.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin

ayat.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
ayat.transliteration: Irama thati alAAimadi

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
ayat.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi

ayat.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
ayat.transliteration: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi

ayat.arabic: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
ayat.transliteration: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
ayat.transliteration: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi

ayat.arabic: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
ayat.transliteration: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada

ayat.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
ayat.transliteration: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
ayat.transliteration: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
ayat.transliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayat.transliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni

ayat.arabic: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا
ayat.transliteration: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman

ayat.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا
ayat.transliteration: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
ayat.transliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
ayat.transliteration: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan

ayat.arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
ayat.transliteration: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee

ayat.arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
ayat.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
ayat.transliteration: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun

ayat.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
ayat.transliteration: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu

ayat.arabic: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ
ayat.transliteration: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan

ayat.arabic: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
ayat.transliteration: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee

ayat.arabic: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
ayat.transliteration: Waodkhulee jannatee

ayat.arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
ayat.transliteration: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi

ayat.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
ayat.transliteration: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi

ayat.arabic: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayat.transliteration: Wawalidin wama walada

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
ayat.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
ayat.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا
ayat.transliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayat.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
ayat.transliteration: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni

ayat.arabic: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
ayat.transliteration: Walisanan washafatayni

ayat.arabic: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
ayat.transliteration: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni

ayat.arabic: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
ayat.transliteration: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu

ayat.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayat.transliteration: Fakku raqabatin

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

ayat.arabic: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
ayat.transliteration: Yateeman tha maqrabatin

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Olaika ashabu almaymanati

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

ayat.arabic: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
ayat.transliteration: AAalayhim narun musadatun

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waalshshamsi waduhaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waalqamari itha talaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha jallaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghshaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waalssamai wama banaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waalardi wama tahaha

ayat.arabic: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Wanafsin wama sawwaha

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaha

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waqad khaba man dassaha

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
ayat.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha

ayat.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
ayat.transliteration: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghsha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha tajalla

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Inna saAAyakum lashatta

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa

ayat.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wasaddaqa bialhusna

ayat.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wakaththaba bialhusna

ayat.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Inna AAalayna lalhuda

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola

ayat.arabic: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Faanthartukum naran talaththa

ayat.arabic: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
ayat.transliteration: La yaslaha illa alashqa

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee kaththaba watawalla

ayat.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
ayat.transliteration: Wasayujannabuha alatqa

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka

ayat.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla

ayat.arabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Walasawfa yarda

ayat.arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Waaldduha

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Waallayli itha saja

ayat.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

ayat.arabic: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Walalakhiratu khayrun laka mina aloola

ayat.arabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa

ayat.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wawajadaka dallan fahada

ayat.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Wawajadaka AAailan faaghna

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
ayat.transliteration: Faamma alyateema fala taqhar

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ
ayat.transliteration: Waamma alssaila fala tanhar

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ
ayat.transliteration: Waamma biniAAmati rabbika fahaddith

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
ayat.transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadraka

ayat.arabic: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ
ayat.transliteration: WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee anqada thahraka

ayat.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ
ayat.transliteration: WarafaAAna laka thikraka

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
ayat.transliteration: Fainna maAAa alAAusri yusran

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا
ayat.transliteration: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusran

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
ayat.transliteration: Faitha faraghta fainsab

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
ayat.transliteration: Waila rabbika fairghab

ayat.arabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ
ayat.transliteration: Waaltteeni waalzzaytooni

ayat.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayat.transliteration: Watoori seeneena

ayat.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Wahatha albaladi alameeni

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
ayat.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayat.transliteration: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileena

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
ayat.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

ayat.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayat.transliteration: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu bialddeeni

ayat.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
ayat.transliteration: Alaysa Allahu biahkami alhakimeena

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ
ayat.transliteration: Iqra biismi rabbika allathee khalaqa

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ
ayat.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min AAalaqin

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ
ayat.transliteration: Iqra warabbuka alakramu

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee AAallama bialqalami

ayat.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ
ayat.transliteration: AAallama alinsana ma lam yaAAlam

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla inna alinsana layatgha

ayat.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: An raahu istaghna

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Inna ila rabbika alrrujAAa

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Araayta allathee yanha

ayat.arabic: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: AAabdan itha salla

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Araayta in kana AAala alhuda

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Aw amara bialttaqwa

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayat.transliteration: Araayta in kaththaba watawalla

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayat.transliteration: Alam yaAAlam bianna Allaha yara

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

ayat.arabic: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Nasiyatin kathibatin khatiatin

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: FalyadAAu nadiyahu

ayat.arabic: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayat.transliteration: SanadAAu alzzabaniyata

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩
ayat.transliteration: Kalla la tutiAAhu waosjud waiqtarib

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylati alqadri

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Wama adraka ma laylatu alqadri

ayat.arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
ayat.transliteration: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

ayat.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
ayat.transliteration: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAi alfajri

ayat.arabic: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu

ayat.arabic: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
ayat.transliteration: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Feeha kutubun qayyimatun

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
ayat.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
ayat.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati

ayat.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu

ayat.arabic: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
ayat.transliteration: Itha zulzilati alardu zilzalaha

ayat.arabic: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waakhrajati alardu athqalaha

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
ayat.transliteration: Waqala alinsanu ma laha

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
ayat.transliteration: Yawmaithin tuhaddithu akhbaraha

ayat.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
ayat.transliteration: Bianna rabbaka awha laha

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayat.transliteration: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

ayat.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا
ayat.transliteration: WaalAAadiyati dabhan

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا
ayat.transliteration: Faalmooriyati qadhan

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا
ayat.transliteration: Faalmugheerati subhan

ayat.arabic: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا
ayat.transliteration: Faatharna bihi naqAAan

ayat.arabic: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا
ayat.transliteration: Fawasatna bihi jamAAan

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ
ayat.transliteration: Inna alinsana lirabbihi lakanoodun

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ
ayat.transliteration: Wainnahu AAala thalika lashaheedun

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayat.transliteration: Wainnahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeedun

ayat.arabic: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
ayat.transliteration: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

ayat.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayat.transliteration: Wahussila ma fee alssudoori

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ
ayat.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yawmaithin lakhabeerun

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayat.transliteration: AlqariAAatu

ayat.arabic: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Ma alqariAAatu

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ
ayat.transliteration: Yawma yakoonu alnnasu kaalfarashi almabthoothi

ayat.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ
ayat.transliteration: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni almanfooshi

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Faamma man thaqulat mawazeenuhu

ayat.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ
ayat.transliteration: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Waamma man khaffat mawazeenuhu

ayat.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: Faommuhu hawiyatun

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ
ayat.transliteration: Wama adraka ma hiyah

ayat.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ
ayat.transliteration: Narun hamiyatun

ayat.arabic: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayat.transliteration: Alhakumu alttakathuru

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ
ayat.transliteration: Hatta zurtumu almaqabira

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayat.transliteration: Thumma kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla law taAAlamoona AAilma alyaqeeni

ayat.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ
ayat.transliteration: Latarawunna aljaheema

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayat.transliteration: Thumma latusalunna yawmaithin AAani alnnaAAeemi

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: WaalAAasri

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ
ayat.transliteration: Inna alinsana lafee khusrin

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
ayat.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٖ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayat.transliteration: Waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالٗا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee jamaAAa malan waAAaddadahu

ayat.arabic: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ
ayat.transliteration: Yahsabu anna malahu akhladahu

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Kalla layunbathanna fee alhutamati

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alhutamatu

ayat.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ
ayat.transliteration: Naru Allahi almooqadatu

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ
ayat.transliteration: Allatee tattaliAAu AAala alafidati

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةٞ
ayat.transliteration: lnnaha AAalayhim musadatun

ayat.arabic: فِي عَمَدٖ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ
ayat.transliteration: Fee AAamadin mumaddadatin

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
ayat.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلٖ
ayat.transliteration: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleelin

ayat.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ
ayat.transliteration: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeela

ayat.arabic: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٖ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ
ayat.transliteration: Tarmeehim bihijaratin min sijjeelin

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفٖ مَّأۡكُولِۭ
ayat.transliteration: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin makoolin

ayat.arabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ
ayat.transliteration: Lieelafi qurayshin

ayat.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ
ayat.transliteration: Eelafihim rihlata alshshitai waalssayfi

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ
ayat.transliteration: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayti

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayat.transliteration: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

ayat.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
ayat.transliteration: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAu alyateema

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

ayat.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ
ayat.transliteration: Fawaylun lilmusalleena

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ
ayat.transliteration: Allatheena hum AAan salatihim sahoona

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ
ayat.transliteration: Allatheena hum yuraoona

ayat.arabic: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ
ayat.transliteration: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoona

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ
ayat.transliteration: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

ayat.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ
ayat.transliteration: Fasalli lirabbika wainhar

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ
ayat.transliteration: Inna shaniaka huwa alabtaru

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
ayat.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroona

ayat.arabic: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayat.transliteration: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoona

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
ayat.transliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ
ayat.transliteration: Wala ana AAabidun ma AAabadtum

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
ayat.transliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

ayat.arabic: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ
ayat.transliteration: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni

ayat.arabic: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ
ayat.transliteration: Itha jaa nasru Allahi waalfathu

ayat.arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
ayat.transliteration: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
ayat.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

ayat.arabic: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ
ayat.transliteration: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayat.transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

ayat.arabic: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ
ayat.transliteration: Sayasla naran thata lahabin

ayat.arabic: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ
ayat.transliteration: Waimraatuhu hammalata alhatabi

ayat.arabic: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ
ayat.transliteration: Fee jeediha hablun min masadin

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayat.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayat.transliteration: Allahu alssamadu

ayat.arabic: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
ayat.transliteration: Lam yalid walam yooladu

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
ayat.transliteration: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
ayat.transliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alfalaqi

ayat.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayat.transliteration: Min sharri ma khalaqa

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayat.transliteration: Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqaba

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ
ayat.transliteration: Wamin sharri alnnaffathati fee alAAuqadi

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayat.transliteration: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alnnasi

ayat.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Maliki alnnasi

ayat.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Ilahi alnnasi

ayat.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoori alnnasi

ayat.arabic: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayat.transliteration: Mina aljinnati wa alnnasm
